03 / 07.02.2025 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Kamdara P.S. Case No. 56 of 2022 corresponding to POCSO Case No. 82 of 2022 for the offences registered under sections 376(2) (n),
307 and 325 of the Indian Penal Code and section 6 of POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Exclusive Special Judge, POCSO-cum-Additional Sessions Judge-IV, Gumla.

entities.text: Exclusive Special Judge, POCSO-cum-Additional Sessions Judge-IV, Gumla
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Petitioner is alleged to have forcibly established physical relationship with the victim.
Statement of the victim was recorded during the trial in which she has supported the prosecution case.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the medical report does not corroborates the allegation made in the FIR.
5. Considering the nature of allegation, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, his prayer for bail stands rejected.
(Ambuj Nath, J) Ranjeet/ Uploaded Basant Sahu vs The State Of Jharkhand --- --- Opp. Party on 7 February, 2025
